opportunities.exact_claim: There exist explicit PPT maps Phi1,Phi2:M_10->M_10 with Phi2 o Phi1 not entanglement breaking; more strongly, there exists an explicit trace-preserving PPT channel Theta:M_21->M_21 such that Theta^2 is not entanglement breaking.
opportunities.quantifiers_and_scope: One explicit pair/channel; same channel in both positions for the M_21 statement. No minimal-dimension claim and no conclusion about Theta^3.
opportunities.historical_obstruction: The general PPT-squared composition conjecture asks whether every composition of compatible PPT maps is entanglement breaking. Primary pre-2026 sources prove d<=3 and leave the general case open.

primary_sources.title: Christandl, Muller-Hermes, Wolf, When Do Composed Maps Become Entanglement Breaking?
primary_sources.relevant_claim: PPT-squared conjecture, qutrit result, and limits of prior Schmidt-number methods.

primary_sources.title: Park, Every PPT Channel Has Finite Entanglement Breaking Index, v2
primary_sources.relevant_claim: Theorem 1.1 gives finite EB index; lines 50-60 of v2 still describe PPT-squared as open. This version predates the local 2026-09-27 candidate manuscript.

opportunities.mechanism: A 4-dimensional PPT map has 20 rank-deficient projective outputs. The symmetric square embeds quadratic evaluations into dimension 10; an exterior-square and complementary-pair construction gives a nonzero positive Choi matrix Z with 20 Veronese product vectors in its kernel. General position ensures each nonzero quadratic vanishes on at most 9 of the 20 directions, so the range of Z contains no product vector and Z is nonseparable. A two-block plus flag channel completion makes the map trace preserving on dimension 21; a Choi corner of Theta^2 is a positive multiple of Z.
load_bearing_obligations: Replay the complex product-free-range argument and the exact twenty-direction quadratic general-position certificate.
Check both explicit maps are PPT under the stated Choi/transposition convention.
Check the flag-completion trace-preserving identity and that compression of J(Theta^2) is exactly a positive multiple of Z.
early_falsifiers: A nonzero product vector in range(Z), or a separable decomposition of Z.
Failure of PPT or trace preservation for the explicit Theta.
A mismatch or nonpositive scalar in the Choi-corner composition identity.

evidence.limitations: Formal files are present and directly inspected; no Lean build, full dependency audit, or external specialist review was performed in this scout.

opportunities.resources_and_costs: Explicit finite algebra; M_10 composite Choi matrix is 100x100. The completed channel has dimension 21 and no minimality or efficient physical implementation claim is established.
opportunities.recommendation: Audit this exact counterexample before pursuing another asymptotic rank obstruction.

opportunities.exact_claim: For every integer r>=1 and every d>=2^23 r^3, there exists a real-coefficient complex-linear unital trace-preserving positive map P:M_d->M_d with P o T=P=T o P, such that P and P* are r-EB, P is indecomposable, and inf over decomposable D of ||P-D||_diamond >= 6/55. At r=2, d>=2^26=67,108,864 is a sufficient dimension.
opportunities.quantifiers_and_scope: For each finite r a possibly different dimension and map exist. P is not CP and is not a physical channel. This does not give one fixed map positive under every tensor power.
opportunities.historical_obstruction: DMS Definition 3.1 and Open Problem 1 ask whether every 2-EB map is decomposable. The claimed r=2 instance is a direct negative answer if its proof is correct.

primary_sources.title: Devendra, Mallick, Sumesh, Mapping Cone of k-Entanglement Breaking Maps, v2
primary_sources.relevant_claim: Definition 3.1 at HTML lines 190-193; Open Problem 1 at lines 1009-1014.

primary_sources.title: Huber, Lami, Lancien, Muller-Hermes, High-Dimensional Entanglement in States with Positive Partial Transposition
primary_sources.relevant_claim: Prior identity-plus-Gaussian and restricted-Schmidt-witness constructions; Gaussian mechanism alone is not novel.

opportunities.mechanism: A zero-marginal, real-symmetric, partial-transpose-invariant Gaussian perturbation G is selected with bounded global operator norm, large Hilbert-Schmidt mass, and small bilinear norm on all complex Schmidt-rank-r vectors. A single witness W=I-32G is block positive on both low-Schmidt cones and pairs negatively with a PPT state rho, proving indecomposability with a diamond-norm gap. Every r-dimensional first-factor compression of W lies in an operator-norm separable ball, which gives universal r-reference separability for P and P* via local filtering.
load_bearing_obligations: Independently check the complex-rank Gaussian net and no-log-dimension rank-k to rank-2k extension, including constants.
Check the dimension-asymmetric separable-ball lemma for noncommuting Hermitian blocks.
Check Choi normalization, transpose symmetries, and the local-filter formula that covers all complex inputs and singular Schmidt bases.
early_falsifiers: A counterexample to the universal complex-rank bilinear bound at the claimed constants.
A counterexample to ||E||_op<=1/(2r-1) implying I+E separable for arbitrary output dimension.
A Choi normalization or compression identity failure, or a decomposable map below the claimed diamond gap.

evidence.limitations: ASTRA labels the result source-derived and unreviewed. The proof is a Gaussian existence argument; no admitted d=67-million matrix is materialized, and historical priority is unknown.

opportunities.resources_and_costs: The proof is analytic and finite but dense materialization scales as O(d^4) scalar entries. At the r=2 sufficient dimension, this is not practical as a stored matrix. Finite numerical samples cannot certify the universal low-rank inequalities.
opportunities.recommendation: Use as the fallback validation target if the PPT-square candidate fails or reveals a repairable local defect.

open_gates_and_barriers.barrier: d=4 PPT outside DSP2 requires a globally valid complex Schmidt-rank-two witness; sampled, real-only, and failed Breuer-Hall witnesses do not pass.

Large DSP rank does not obstruct a physical PPT-channel square or cube; both N215 and N225 admit EB-square examples. A composition-sensitive physical witness or universal composition theorem is required.
For every finite r there exists P_r is not a single fixed P positive at all tensor powers. Dimension and map vary with r.
Common-EB arbitrary-rank comparison is assigned to the separate Sol scout; this report does not duplicate its search.

astra_card_findings.finding: Source-claimed linear DSP-rank lower bound K(d)>=floor(d/2^24)+1, improved by a PT-invariant ensemble to floor(d/2^23)+1. Does not settle exact K(d) or d=4,k=2.
Two-image Gaussian width, dimension-asymmetric separable-compression ball, and complex low-rank bilinear net are the source-claimed proof mechanisms; not independently replayed.
Source-claimed physical PPT channels with EB squares; N225 has EB index exactly 2. These do not refute PPT cubed.
N216 excludes only the stated predetermined isometry family. N217's Breuer-Hall two-copositivity proposal fails at d=6,k=2 with exact value -1.
Source and validation scopes remain explicitly unreviewed; intake/indexing and finite fixtures are not scientific replay or external validation.

N223's engineered state is one-copy distillable on a 2-versus-rest grouped cut. N224's local inter-copy Bell state blocks a naive multiplicative overlap transfer but does not settle all-copy undistillability.

source_audit_notes: Park v2 Theorem 5.5's printed transposed DSP2 summand appears to have a Phi_1/Phi_2 composition mismatch and missing transpose relocation. The identity T o Ad_L=Ad_conjugate(L) o T plus PPT of Phi_1/Phi_2 appears to repair it; treat as likely typesetting/proof-line mismatch, not a theorem falsifier.
rejected_transfers: N213/N220 asymptotic DSP rank growth is not a PPT-composition witness.
N215/N225 Gaussian PPT channels with EB square do not refute PPT cubed.
N217 Breuer-Hall two-copositivity ansatz fails exactly at d=6,k=2 with value -1.
N223 engineered factorial family is one-copy distillable across its two-versus-rest grouped cut; it is not an NPT bound-entanglement example on that cut.
N224 local inter-copy Bell states make the naive multiplicative overlap transfer fail; this does not settle all-copy undistillability.
Approximate marginal broadcasting with errors tending to zero does not imply a common EB decoder without uniform complexity or covering control.
selection: Audit the dimension-21 PPT-square candidate first; independently reconstruct the r=2 N219 proof second. Do not infer tensor-stable positivity, classicality, or bound entanglement from the weaker interfaces above.
